subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The athlete looked __unsettled__ before the race.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"unsettled"** means feeling anxious, nervous, or uneasy. (अशांत)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt** unsettled** about moving to a new city.
 
 
 
• **"Confident"** refers to having a strong belief in one's abilities or qualities, feeling self-assured. (आत्मविश्वासी)
 
 
• **Example: **The student was **confident **about passing the exam with flying colors.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'unsettled'** is **'confident'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reticent** (मितभाषी): Not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily.

 
 
• **Example:** She was reticent about her personal life.
 
 
 
• **Triumphant** (विजयी): Feeling or expressing jubilation after having won a victory or mastered a difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** The team returned home triumphant after winning the championship.
 
 
 
• **Tangent** (स्पर्शरेखा): A completely different line of thought or action.
 
 
• **Example:** He went off on a tangent during the meeting.
 
 

43:Tc00,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
